column2: You know... When you wouldn't wake up, I felt so alone.
it feels as though something I'd forgotten might come back to me!
No matter how much you may come to hate me... these feelings will never change.
I want us to stay together... forever...
I felt as though my heart would break...
I kept thinking: What would I do if you died...?
If I have you at my side, I don't need anything else...
For you... I could do anything!!
Even if it were... something steeped in $$罪$$...
